The '''Resistance Generals''' were the six runners-up in the [[Resistance Movement]] leader election after the winner, {{RN|pig|rank=f|Technoblade}}, who became the {{NPCSprite|Technoblade|f}} [[Resistance Leader]]. While the Leader received a full set of perks, the six Generals each received one. The Generals were {{RN|yt|rank=f|FurryEBoy}} (now known as {{RN|yt|rank=f|tylerwith4rs}}), {{RN|yt|rank=f|56ms}}, {{RN|a|rank=f|TimeDeo}}, {{RN|mvp++|rank=f|2nfg}} (who was banned), {{RN|yt|rank=f|thirtyvirus}}, and {{RN|yt|rank=f|Refraction}}.

After their victory over {{NPCSprite|Dante}}, the Generals (excluding {{RN|mvp++|rank=f|2nfg}}) became {{RN|pig|rank=f|Technoblade}}'s Ministers when he became [[Mayor Election|Mayor]].

__TOC__

== Location ==
Before the Uprising, the Generals could be found behind {{NPCSprite|Clerk Seraphine;Seraphine}} in the {{Zone|Dark Auction}} on the basement stage. The Dark Auction house is located at {{Coordinates|91|75|176}} in the {{Zone|Wilderness}}, near the [[Wilderness#Fairy_Pond|Fairy Pond]]. After the Uprising, they moved to the {{Zone|Community Center}} and became Ministers, save for {{RN|mvp++|rank=f|2nfg}}.

== Trivia ==
* As a General, {{RN|mvp++|rank=f|2nfg}} had iron bars surrounding him, referencing that he was banned when the Resistance Leader election ended.
** This is likely why his perk is the only one with a negative effect: reducing all players' {{Stat|int}} by 1.
* The Generals were the first people to become Ministers, and the only ones to have the position before it was fully introduced in [[Changelog/2024/July_2|SkyBlock version 0.20.3]].
** This was also the first time that a Mayor had more than one Minister, and the only time until the [[Minister Election]] was added.
* Each General's perk is a callback about them:
** '''Better Together''' - {{RN|yt|rank=f|FurryEBoy}}'s perk only affecting players on the same public island as a party member links to his YouTube channel being co-owned with Hellcastle and them playing as a duo.
** '''Infestation''' - {{RN|yt|rank=f|56ms}}' perk is a reference to an ongoing joke about him being a rat. This is due to him playing a game called [[w:Escape_from_Tarkov|Escape from Tarkov]] in which he’d title streams "Rat Hunting", leading fans to start calling him a rat. His perk introduces [[Rat|Rats]] and the {{Item|Rat Pet}}.
** '''Blessing of the Fairies''' - {{RN|a|rank=f|TimeDeo}}'s perk boosting {{Item|Fairy Soul}} stats is a reference to his popular guides on finding them.
** '''Why am I here''' - {{RN|mvp++|rank=f|2nfg}}'s perk name is a joke about him being elected for apparently no reason, considering he was banned at the time. He also never became a Minister.
** '''What did it cost''' - {{RN|yt|rank=f|thirtyvirus}}'s perk name is a direct callback to the movie [[w:Avengers:_Infinity_War|Avengers: Infinity War]]. The {{Item|Spiked Atrocity}} originates from him calling the {{Item|Spiked Bait}} "ThanoFish" in reference to the appearance of the film's antagonist, Thanos.
** '''Incredible Luck''' - {{RN|yt|rank=f|Refraction}}'s perk is a joke on his unluckiness even with extremely high {{Stat|mf}}, resulting in him calling {{Stat|mf}} useless multiple times. The extra loot in [[Dungeon Reward Chest|Dungeon Reward Chests]] is another joke on his unluckiness, as he very rarely drops good items in [[Dungeons]] on streams or in videos.
* Seraphine was a runner-up in the election, though it appears that this was a player, not the actual NPC.
